notes: Access route: direct requests were 403'd by Etsy's bot defense; curl_cffi with impersonate='chrome116' succeeded consistently (chrome110 failed, chrome116 worked) -- Rule 2 step 2. robots.txt (fetched directly, not via translate.goog) has only 3 User-agent blocks (Spinn3r, AdsBot-Google-Mobile, *) -- no ClaudeBot/GPTBot/CCBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-User entry and no Claude-specific Disallow, so this is not a blocked-by-policy case like Amazon UAE. Scope: per this window's brief note, scoped to Etsy's Home & Living taxonomy: Home Decor (full traversal), Lighting (full traversal incl. the Outdoor Lighting node which lives under Outdoor & Garden), Kitchen & Dining (Drink & Barware / Dining & Serving / Kitchen Decor branches, for tableware/dinnerware/glassware only), Bathroom (Bathroom Decor branch only, for genuinely decorative accessories), and Outdoor & Garden's Garden Decoration + Planters & Pots branches (Rule 0.4/0.5: outdoor is not a blanket exclusion). Art & Collectibles (Etsy's separate top-level department that also carries wall-art prints/paintings) was NOT traversed -- out of the Home & Living scope this window's brief specifies for Etsy. Exclusions applied: Throw Pillows, Chair Pads (textiles); Wallpaper, Seasonal Decor (Ornaments/Christmas Trees/Easter Baskets/Tree Toppers/Tree Skirts/Stockings -- Holiday & Gift); Faux Plants and Greenery, Artificial Flower Arrangements, Fresh Flower Arrangements (faux/fresh flowers -- Fresh treated as perishable consumable, not durable decor); Decorative Baskets (storage function, conservative exclude); Light Switch and Outlet Covers, Light Pulls, Ceiling Medallions, Lamp Harps (Light Accessories branch -- treated as wiring/hardware/trim, not fixtures); Home Fragrances and the general 'Candles' node (scented/unscented mixed roll-up with no clean split -- dropped per 'mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad'; Candleholders kept, matches brief's explicit include); Flatware and Silverware, Serving Utensils, Chopsticks (cutlery/utensils); Barware (sample titles showed a genuine mix of glass barware AND bar tools/openers -- dropped as a mixed roll-up, brief explicitly excludes 'bar tools'); Olive Oil and Vinegar Cruets (sample titles were dominated by actual bottled-oil food products, not empty decorative cruets -- food/drink consumable); Refrigerator Magnets (novelty, not in include list); Wall Stencils, Wall Shelves (tool / storage-furniture); Bathroom Vanities, Bath Towels, Toilet Paper Holders, Towel Racks and Rods, Shower Curtains and Rings, Beach Towels, Soap Dishes and Dispensers, Bathroom Storage, Bath Mats and Rugs, Medicine Cabinets, Bathtub Trays, Hooded Towels (bathroom furniture/fixtures/plumbing/textiles, not mirrors/lighting); all of Furniture, Floor & Rugs, Bedding, Curtains & Window Treatments (textiles/furniture), Storage & Organization, Cookware/Bakeware/Small Kitchen Appliances/Coffee & Tea Makers/Kitchen Storage/Linens, and the rest of Outdoor & Garden (Patio Furniture, Gardening Tools, Fire Pits, Grills, Coolers, etc.) were not traversed at all as clearly out of scope. Kept borderline calls, documented for review: Dried Flowers (kept as durable decorative florals, distinct from the excluded faux/fresh nodes); Picture Frames/Displays/Collage Frames (kept -- matches this project's precedent on West Elm/Crate & Barrel/Pottery Barn/Target Home, all of which include picture frames under Wall Decor & Mirrors); Wreaths and Door Hangers (kept as year-round decorative accents -- Etsy itself keeps this branch separate from Seasonal Decor); Fireplace Screens, Mobiles (kept as decorative accessories); Serving Odds and Ends (kept -- sample titles were vintage decorative serveware: butter dishes, creamers, sugar bowls); Cheese and Charcuterie Boards, Lazy Susans, Snack Sets (kept under Trays and Platters as tableware/serving decor). Rule 0.6 overlaps (both nodes emitted, not de-duplicated, product-ID diff not feasible at this scale): Home Decor > Clocks (all clock types) vs Wall Decor > Wall Clocks (distinct category IDs/URLs); Lighting > Garden and String Lights vs Outdoor & Garden > Outdoor Lighting (distinct category IDs/URLs, own canonical page); Home Decor > Indoor Planters vs Outdoor & Garden > Planters and Pots > Indoor Planters (distinct URLs). QTY DETERMINATION (why every leaf is null+MANUAL REVIEW): Etsy category/browse pages carry no rendered or embedded exact result-count field. The only numeric signal is an embedded search-state "total_pages" value (48 listings/page). For 48 of 85 leaves this value sits at the hard cap of 250 pages (~12,000), which Etsy enforces regardless of true inventory size for any sufficiently large category -- the real total is unknown and likely far larger (a global 'organic_listings_count':19,400,388 site-wide figure was also found in the page JSON and is unusable, since it is a sitewide marketing stat, not category-scoped). For the other 37 leaves, total_pages is below the cap, but boundary testing (fetching the last page and counting actual listing IDs) showed the per-page item count is inflated by ad/related-listing injection beyond the nominal 48/page, and a repeat-request check on one such category (Cake Stands) showed total_pages itself change between two back-to-back fetches (133 -> 131) -- i.e. the figure is not even stable within a session, let alone an exact site-reported total. This is the same class of problem as Noon UAE's rounded '100K+' widget (S.N. 191 precedent) but with instability and ad-pollution rather than rounding as the failure mode; per the brief's explicit guidance for this company, every qty is null + MANUAL REVIEW rather than estimated.
